subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw adopt first-party Wear OS support from this branch now, stage it into smaller maintainer-owned PRs, or leave Wear OS outside the first-party app for now?
rationale: The PR adds a new shipped app, auth/storage behavior, and Android release/CI surface; the code blockers are concrete, but the product direction and long-term owner need maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt After Blockers
options.body: Keep this branch as the source, rebase it, fix the security/gate/auth findings, and require stronger real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Stage Smaller Slices
options.body: Preserve source credit while splitting shared gateway helpers, phone proxying, Wear UI, and tile/notification support into smaller maintainer-reviewed PRs.

options.title: Pause Direction
options.body: Leave this branch unmerged or close later after maintainer discussion if first-party Wear OS is not a current release priority.

recommendation.title: Adopt After Blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this branch as the source, rebase it, fix the security/gate/auth findings, and require stronger real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the live assignee and has direct continuity with the Wear branch.
